spec:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: review reference for one playable character in Detonarium, before image-to-3D modeling.
Primary request: One original costumed adventurer or creature with the collectible painted-vinyl toy appearance of the game's chunky ninja and monster toys. The character is NOT a robot.
Scene/backdrop: plain very light warm grey seamless studio background with only a soft contact shadow.
Style/medium: polished 3D toy product render, matte painted vinyl, softly beveled sculpted shapes, restrained material detail, delightful expressive character design.
Composition/framing: a single full-body character, centered, near-front three-quarter view turned only 10 degrees; camera level at mid torso, very little perspective; entire ears/hat and boots visible with generous margin. Relaxed symmetric A pose, arms 25 degrees away from torso, empty hands, feet flat with a clear gap, all four limbs clearly readable. Head approximately 40 percent of total height, legs substantial enough for a believable walk/run, not tiny pegs.
Lighting/mood: soft broad studio key, gentle fill, clean readable silhouette.
Materials/textures: sculpted toy skin, costume folds and painted surfaces; no realistic fur, pores, fabric fuzz, exposed ball joints, hinges or machine hardware.
Constraints: one character only, one view only, no companion props, no text, lettering, logo, watermark, labels, border or base. No robot, mech, digital face, glowing visor, armor plating, exposed mechanical joints, wires, floating accessories, skinny limbs or weapons.
Color palette: dominant blue, retain this player's unmistakable color identity.
Subject: A plucky little human coastal salvage adventurer with a round warm tan face, broad expressive dark painted eyes, tiny rounded nose, and a tuft of curly dark hair. Wears a cobalt-blue soft fisherman diving hood folded back around the head, large amber-lens goggles pushed up on the forehead so the face is fully visible, a thick blue waterproof jacket with brass toggles, cream mittens, navy trousers and oversized blue rubber boots. Short compact air cylinder on the back with no long tubes. The rounded blue hood and chunky boots define a friendly nautical silhouette, no metal globe helmet and no face screen.

Create ONE new enemy creature reference image for the mobile 3D arena game Detonarium. Do not copy the humanoid bomber and do not include it. Asset: DRIFTER. A compact round rose-crimson mechanical puff beetle, wider than tall, rounded segmented shell with a dark horizontal face recess and TWO large warm ivory eyes, mischievous heavy eyelids, two short backward-curving ear fins, tiny charcoal lower body and two broad stubby dark feet. A little raised dorsal shell ridge, no long fragile appendages, no arms, no weapons, no letters. Its outline should say a bouncing round creature rather than a plain sphere. Dominant muted rose-red shell, charcoal face and feet, warm ivory eyes. One coherent bilateral creature, front three-quarter view from slightly above, full object centred occupying about 80% of a square frame. Pose symmetrical and neutral so a 3D reconstruction can infer its other side. Plain solid light grey background, no ground plane, no cast shadow, even diffuse studio lighting without dramatic highlights or baked glow. Only ONE view and ONE creature, no layout panels, no text, no watermark. This image will be the single image-to-3D reconstruction input.
